content.short: Begin Wallet is a multi-chain crypto wallet for Cardano, Bitcoin, Solana, NFTs, DeFi, and self-custody.
content.description: Begin Wallet is a self-custody wallet that supports Cardano, Bitcoin, Solana, NFTs, and DeFi from one interface. Users can manage assets under a single recovery phrase, send and receive crypto, buy supported tokens, and participate in on-chain applications without moving between separate wallets. On Cardano, Begin also supports metadata ratings stored on-chain, giving users a way to share real feedback about assets and experiences. Its goal is to make everyday wallet use more welcoming for new and active crypto users.
content.meta: Begin Wallet helps users manage Cardano, Bitcoin, Solana, NFTs, and DeFi from one wallet. Explore Begin Wallet on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
